mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO declines > 1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.5% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 3 months and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% in 3 months and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST rises > 5% and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a strong economy, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 shows a sustained increase.
